[IDSP.6.6] **No engine-side per-call deadline.** Per
LCRS.7.3, adapters time out, not the engine.
Authors who care about adapter latency write
absence matchers over the response schema
([LCRS.7.1]). The engine never synthesises a
response fact or a `CallError`; the integrator asserts
them via `ds_engine_assert` when the external operation
completes or fails, and never from inside the callback
([NCBK.6.4], [RARC.13.16]).
